channel-type.label: Last Successful Update
channel-type.description: Time of the last successful retrieval of the installation status from TCC, not the sensor measurement time.

channel-type.label: System Mode
channel-type.description: Gets the system mode. Commands set a permanent mode. Auto preserves individual zone overrides; Reset also cancels them.

channel-type.label: System Mode Until
channel-type.description: Expiry reported by TCC for a temporary system mode. Undefined for a permanent mode or an unknown expiry.

channel-type.label: Permanent Mode
channel-type.description: ON when TCC reports a permanent system mode, OFF for a temporary mode, or undefined when unknown.

channel-type.label: Reset to Schedule
channel-type.description: Send ON to select Auto and cancel all heating zone and hot water overrides on this controller.

channel-type.label: Set Point
channel-type.description: Gets or sets this zone's target temperature. An active temporary override keeps its expiry; other commands create a permanent override. 0 cancels the override.

channel-type.label: Temporary Set Point
channel-type.description: Shows the current target temperature. Commands set a temporary target using the configured duration, two hours by default. Read the resulting mode and expiry from SetPointStatus and SetPointUntil.

channel-type.label: Set Point Until
channel-type.description: Expiry time of the active temporary zone override. Undefined when no temporary override is active.

channel-type.label: Set Point Status
channel-type.description: Gets or sets the zone override mode. FollowSchedule cancels the override; PermanentOverride or TemporaryOverride applies the current target temperature in that mode.

channel-type.label: Weekly Schedule
channel-type.description: Weekly heating program in canonical JSON. Days are ordered Monday to Sunday; switch points use sorted local times and temperatures in Celsius.

channel-type.label: Next Switch Point
channel-type.description: Next switch point in the normal weekly heating program, calculated in the location's time zone. System modes and zone overrides do not alter this value.

channel-type.label: Next Scheduled Temp
channel-type.description: Target temperature at the next normal weekly program switch point. System modes and zone overrides are not applied to this value.

channel-type.label: Schedule Updated
channel-type.description: Time of the last successful retrieval of this zone's weekly heating program from TCC. Unchanged after a failed schedule request.
